chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, said:
I asked him about salat (prayer) in a jurmuq, and I brought him a jurmuq that I had sent to him, so he said: “One may perform salat (prayer) in it.”

Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: A shirt is sufficient for a man in salat (prayer) if it is thick, and a woman must have a shift and a khimar in salat (prayer). The explanation of that has already passed previously in full, so there is no point in repeating it, if Allah, the Exalted, wills.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer whose clothing requirements are being discussed
key_terms.جُرْمُوقٍ: a type of footwear or leather overshoe in which salat (prayer) is being asked about
key_terms.خِمَارٍ: a head covering required for a woman in prayer
key_terms.دِرْعٍ: a woman's garment or shift required for prayer
key_terms.صَفِيقًا: thick or dense; describing the shirt as adequately concealing
key_terms.قَمِيصٌ: a shirt; mentioned as sufficient clothing for a man in prayer if thick
key_terms.يُصَلَّى: it is prayed in; indicating permissibility of performing salat (prayer) in that item

ai.seo_question: What clothing is sufficient for a man or woman to perform salat (prayer), and is prayer valid in a jurmuq?
ai.summary: This report addresses the permissibility of performing salat (prayer) while wearing a jurmuq and affirms that prayer in it is valid. It also records a legal ruling that a man may pray in a thick shirt, while a woman requires both a garment and a khimar for prayer.
